shared_file_insertions.inserted_text: **共同实现与共享身份 / Joint realization and shared identity，2026-10-08。** [新整合与实查](_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/EXPLANATORY-JOINTNESS-INTEGRATION.md)新增56项 Lean 定理／183项含继承审计：明示成对紧致性下，共同问题迫出结构对应并提升有限逐节点方案。实际占用／释放推出共享冲突；全部孤立共同问题仍可能遗漏指定部分的共享身份，固定搭配问题在实例中修复。/ New 6 empty and 50 standard dependencies; full 112 empty and 71 standard. Global concurrent composition and universal uniqueness remain open.

**共同实现的结构内容 / Structural content of joint realization，2026-10-08。** [新连接](unified-2026-10-05/EXPLANATORY-NECESSITY.md#59-从各自可行到共同实现)以56项新 Lean 定理连接成对问题、结构对应与占用／释放，并保留指定部分重复计入的真实反例。/ Joint compactness supports recovery and nodewise plan lifting; contextual identity needs more than isolated profiles, and general concurrent composition remains open.

**Explanatory jointness, 8 October 2026.** [Ren’s continuation](15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-10-08-generative-explanatory-necessity.md#继续共同实现--continue-joint-realization) advances the same necessity inquiry. [Primary-source assessment](../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/EXPLANATORY-JOINTNESS-INTEGRATION.md#7-counterreview-and-primary-sources) credits Reynolds’s separating conjunction and sharing restrictions; Goranko–Otto introduction/outline access is distinguished from the unread polyadic section. Link-only reading; no source bytes imported or mathematical priority claimed.

**Joint-realization scope → correlated witnesses and contextual identity，2026-10-08。** [The 56-theorem continuation](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/EXPLANATORY-JOINTNESS-INTEGRATION.md) derives step/joint structural correspondence under explicit fiber compactness and question separation, and lifts finite nodewise plans. Acquisition/release histories justify a shared-support distinction absent from the completed-activity interface; an exact reduced slot presentation still loses designated-part aliasing, repaired locally by fixed-partner questions. This advances which relational content a claimed explanatory target requires. Global concurrent composition, general contextual coverage and universal uniqueness remain open; ethical warrant is not inferred. Full audit: 183 declarations, 112 empty and 71 standard dependencies.

**Joint realization and contextual identity, 8 October 2026.** [Integration](EXPLANATORY-JOINTNESS-INTEGRATION.md): 56 new checked theorems / 183 total audits. Correlated-pair compactness supports richer bisimulation, generated structural correspondence and finite nodewise plan lifting. Actual acquisition/release explains the shared-support conflict. Complete isolated joint profiles still lose designated-part aliasing; fixed-partner answers repair the finite witness. General global concurrency and universal uniqueness remain open.

**Joint realization, shared support and occupancy, 8 October 2026.** `ExplanatoryJointness.lean` has 20 new theorems; `ExplanatorySharedSupport.lean` has 25; `ExplanatoryLeaseDynamics.lean` has 11. Run `python3 check_explanatory_jointness.py`: 183 audits, 112 empty and 71 standard; new 6 empty and 50 standard. [Research integration](../../../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/EXPLANATORY-JOINTNESS-INTEGRATION.md) distinguishes correlated matching, nodewise plans, actual overlap, and contextual identity from unconditional concurrent composition.

C30.title_zh: 生成关系的解释必要性
C30.claim_zh: 独立指定的取得、错误与后续问题要求保留实际差异和共同边界；接合探针进一步恢复有限片段接口，三元关系唯一确定局部单位，完整有限轨迹恢复其状态接口。整体表述仍合格，容量反例限定接口匹配的充分性。 最新从原有机制直接证明摘要充分性，推出有效规律与全部有限历史精确对应，不另给Exact或同态前提。 普遍化检验给出任意三元关系恢复的充要条件；完整成功答案与最少状态／边仍允许不同构机制，确定且可达、后续可区分时恢复唯一对应。 后续以共同条件下的复合接续问题推出有限分支双模拟，并由准确约简答案构造可从每个相容原生起点提升的编码规律；结构唯一性不再要求确定性。 再以后继紧致性放宽有限分支，取得结构对应及完整无限编码路径提升；有无限多个可区分后继的正例，也有全部有限复合答案相同而无限持续不同的反例。
C30.claim_en: Independently specified acquisition, error and continuation questions require native distinctions and shared boundaries. Joining probes further recover finite-fragment interfaces; the ternary relation determines unique unit roles, and complete finite traces recover their state interfaces. Global accounts remain eligible; capacity limits matching-unit sufficiency. The latest concrete summary-sufficiency proof derives an effective law and exact finite-history correspondence from the unchanged mechanism, without a separate Exact or homomorphism premise. The universal attempt characterizes arbitrary ternary-relation recovery: complete success answers and minimum states/edges still allow nonisomorphic mechanisms; deterministic reachable continuation-separated realizations recover uniqueness. The continuation derives finite-branch bisimulation from compound questions at shared conditions and reconstructs code histories lifting from every compatible native start; scoped structural uniqueness no longer requires determinism. Successor compactness further replaces finite branching, preserving structural correspondence and lifting whole infinite code runs; a genuinely infinitely branching positive model contrasts with equal finite-modal answers but different infinite realization.
C30.scope_zh: 此前各轮及实际展开42项定理／64项新审计保留原范围与独立评审；本轮另54项（23＋31）／128项含继承审计：105空、23仅propext。探针可用性、状态内容及完整接续条件明示；共享容量／并行冲突下的定义域与输出识别仍待推进。 新增14项定理／18项空依赖审计，另192项继承依赖不变（150空、42标准）；独立审查接受。既有温控／氧梯度证据接入，但不等于该构造的物理实现或普遍根基完成；重叠继承不累加。 此独立一轮61项新定理／135项审计（123空、12继承propext；新61项全空）。已有14项有效规律推导保留；普遍目标为何必须区分相关原生关系仍未证，有限反例不整体否定普遍猜想。 此轮45项新定理／141项审计：103空、38标准；新19空、26标准，其中13含经典选择。有限分支、问题覆盖、约简／状态区分分别明示；前向充分性不恢复全部实际形成史，普遍解释范围仍未证。 此轮36项新定理／159项审计（102空、57标准；新5空、31标准）。后继紧致性是显式充分条件，非普遍定律或有限观察结论；完整持续、实际历史及一般共同接合各保留范围。
C30.scope_en: Earlier studies, including native unfolding (42 theorems / 64 new audits and its independent review), retain their scopes. This separate 54 (23+31) / 128 audit study has 105 empty and 23 propext-only lists. Probe access, state content and completion are explicit; identification with shared-capacity/concurrent conflicts remains open. New 14 theorems / 18 empty audits; 192 inherited maps unchanged (150 empty, 42 standard), independently reviewed. Existing controller/oxygen evidence is integrated without equating those cases with this construction or completing universal grounding. Overlapping imports are not added. This separate round adds 61 theorems / 135 audits (123 empty, 12 inherited propext; all new 61 empty). Existing effective-law results remain credited. Universal separation of native relations remains unwarranted; the scoped counterexample does not globally refute the conjecture. This round: 45 new theorems / 141 audits, 103 empty and 38 standard; new 19 empty and 26 standard, including 13 with classical choice. Finite branching, question coverage and reduction/separation are explicit; forward adequacy does not recover every actual past or prove universal explanatory scope. This round adds 36 theorems / 159 audits (102 empty, 57 standard; new 5 empty, 31 standard). Successor compactness is an explicit sufficient condition, not a universal law or finite-observation inference; whole continuation, actual history and general joint realization retain distinct scopes.

owned_continuations.appended_text:
## 59. 从各自可行到共同实现

如果解释声称覆盖两项活动怎样共同发生，就必须回答它们能否在相同的相关条件下获得相容支持。两项活动各自可以完成，甚至任意次轮流完成，都不保证可以重叠占用同一个支持。这个问题来自共同实现的目标，不能用两份独立成功清单替代。

本轮构造中，两项活动要么都接到同一个支持位置，要么各接到不同位置。每项活动都可以单独取得支持，完成后释放。它们是同一局部配置中的活动、接入、占用和释放关系；没有把“活动主体”和“外部资源”设成两个本体起点。支持独占、可释放及接入方式是这个局部模型的明示规律，不作为全部现实的普遍假设。

## 60. 共同问题能够迫出成对对应

在原有真、原子条件、否定、合取和接续问题之外，加入“这个整体能否有一对相容部分，分别满足这两项要求”。普通合取只要求两项断言在同一条件下都真；新问题要求**同一对相容见证**。

对实际相容的候选对施加紧致性：一组左右要求的每个有限部分若都能由一个相容对满足，就存在一对满足全部要求。有限候选对必然满足它；一般定理也允许无限候选。不能把左右各自候选集的紧致性当作成对相容的充分根据。

Lean 已证明，完整的有限复合答案在逐步后继与共同候选对均满足相应紧致性时，等价于同时保留步骤和成对关系的双模拟。证明先把任意有限多项左要求、右要求各自合取，再用一个共同问题转移它们，最后取得保持全部要求的一对后继。表述中不预先加入关系保持字段；实际对应及问题范围仍需根据。

## 61. 共享冲突由占用和释放推出

在“单项活动已完成并释放”的界面，两种接入安排对所有普通有限复合问题都一致。但共同问题给出相反答案：共享位置不能同时被两项活动独占，不同位置可以。

为使这个差别有实际关系内容，本轮还写出占用过程：取得须有接入且位置空闲，取得之后位置变为已占用；释放须在占用后发生，并使该位置恢复。新证明把普通完成步骤对应到一次真实取得／释放，把共同问题**精确对应到两项活动都已取得支持、但尚未释放的重叠占用**。

任意有限序列的完整活动都可以轮流发生并返回全空闲状态。共享安排中的重叠取得却不可能；不同支持安排中有明确成功历史。因此，完整内部历史并不相同，相同的是已明示的完成活动界面。这是局部表述遗漏关系的实例，不能拿它否定一个已经保留占用关系的更充分解释。

## 62. 存在共同方案仍不等于指定部分可以替换

进一步的反例只有一个整体和两个独占支持位置。两个不同位置可以配对，同一位置不能重复配对。单看每个位置，所有新旧有限问题都一致，连嵌套共同问题也一样；差别出现在它们与具体搭配对象的关系中。

显式的两码表述把整体编码为一类、两个位置编码为另一类。Lean 证明这个表述准确且约简，但任何只读三个这样的码的规则，都不能精确判断三个指定原生位置的共同关系：码上的“两个支持”可以由两个不同位置实现，却不能据此把同一个位置算两次。

这没有要求恢复任意内在名字。固定其中一个搭配位置后，“与它会不会冲突”就能区分两个位置；全部这类搭配答案在该实例中恢复了位置区别。解释若覆盖指定部分之间的相互作用，保留这种情境关系就是目标自身的要求。此前接口探针成果保留；这里明确了整体存在性问题没有自动给出固定搭配问题。

## 63. 有限共同方案与更强结构唯一性

对于准确约简的共同问题编码，合法编码配对可以从任意相容的原生整体实现，得到合适的原生部分；有限嵌套方案也能逐节点这样提升，保留叶端要求。这里允许选择与整体真正相容的部分，不能改写为任取孤立描述相同的具体部分都行。

相关位置可以从同一根部经由接续或相容部分关系到达。若所有相关位置都如此到达，且不同位置能被问题区分，则新证明取得双向唯一对应，同时保持和反映步骤、共同关系。这个范围内的结构唯一性比只保留顺序接续更强。

有限嵌套方案的定理保留每个节点所给的共同关系，没有额外证明所有叶子一定能在一个时段全局并发。跨分支重复支持、时间安排和真实占用范围若不在原生关系中，定理不会自动补齐；也没有偷偷假设结合律、交换律或自由复制。

## 64. 解释必要性现在落到哪些具体关系

可以更具体地要求：**充分解释共同实现，就必须保留哪些见证能够共同成立；充分解释指定部分的相互作用，还必须保留它们与实际搭配对象的相容或冲突。** 一元关系说明中的差异并未被抹去，反而通过它们在同一配置中造成的后果得到辨认。

当前已经证明的是明示规律与紧致性范围内的结构恢复、真实重叠冲突及情境辨别。普遍适用的共同关系、一般全局并发和唯一生成本体仍未证明。静态配置说明若保留同样的接入、占用及搭配后果，也可以充分回答这些问题。下一检验应针对局部相容证书怎样在有跨分支共享时形成一个完整共同实现，而非直接把每个局部证书当作全局充分性。

本轮56项新定理分为20项一般连接、25项支持与共享身份实例、11项占用历史对应。新依赖表为6空、20仅propext、15另含Quot.sound、15再含Classical.choice；127项继承审计保持原范围，完整183项为112空、71标准。分离逻辑和多元模态的已有数学路线获得署名，[完整整合](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/EXPLANATORY-JOINTNESS-INTEGRATION.md)保留假设、反审、来源与检查记录。

**English current summary.** Correlated joint questions force step-and-pair bisimulation under explicit fiber compactness. Generated, question-separated positions have a uniquely matched correspondence preserving both relations. A concrete acquisition/release law distinguishes completed activity from overlapping support. An exact reduced part profile can still lose designated-part sharing; fixed-partner compatibility repairs the finite witness. Finite joint-plan lifting is nodewise, not an unconditional global concurrency or universal-ontology theorem.

## 继续共同实现 / Continue joint realization

在紧致性一轮完成后，Ren 继续要求：

> 继续

AI scope note: advance the same necessary-content investigation into joint realization and shared support. The [new study](../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/EXPLANATORY-JOINTNESS-INTEGRATION.md) checks correlated-pair recovery, actual acquisition/release correspondence, a designated-part sharing obstruction and a fixed-partner repair. These formulations and conclusions are AI-authored. The instruction does not itself assert universal exclusive support, authorize independent agents or request a recurring task.
